text: One of the best routine apps I've ever tried. Used it for several years after getting the premium with a one-time payment. Helps a lot with my executive dysfunction! You can make scheduled routines and flexible ones to do any time. I also like that I can choose to start the routine and add a countdown, but I can also use it kind of as a checklist when I'm in a pinch. The interface is nice and simple, and dark mode is available!
author: Kiona T.

text: Way too expensive for the content. Where is the 7-day free trial is promised, the monthly payment went immediately?
author: Tiina Saastamoinen

text: Really great, helps with many issues related to routines. Easy to use and simple outlook helps focusing on the task. Good notifications and motivating overall theme. Thank you Thomas for creating this great app to help with everyday life. I hope I can afford the Premium in the next few months to help you out;)
author: Karma Rossi

text: Tämä on selkeä (selkeämpi kuin toinen koittamani app, jonka käytön lopetin, kun tuntui liian monimutkaiselta opetella käyttö) ja tykkään, että tehtävä on kirjattava tehdyksi ennenkuin se poistuu kännykän ilmoituksista. Ei voi vain pyyhkäistä pois, mitä olen kyllä yrittänyt. 😆 Ja jokaiselle osatehtävälle on oma kuittauksensa. eim aamurutiineissa aamupalan syönnille, veden juonnille ja päivän tehtävien kirjaukselle. ainakin tähän asti olen ollut tyytyväinen.
author: Tiina K

text: I struggle with ADHD and burn-out challenges and it has been extremely difficult to me to have healthy routines. I started using this app only couple of days ago, but I feel it is already helping me. ❤️
